# FreeCiv AtomSpace mapping inventory

This file is the reviewable snapshot of how FreeCiv game state, rules, and actions map to PLN atoms. A change to `adapter.facts_from_state`, `rules.metta`, or the action schema changes this file — review the git diff. See `docs/atomspace-mapping.md` for the reviewer's guide and checklist.

Confidence conventions: directly-observed facts carry `(stv 1.0 0.99)`; derived/heuristic facts carry `(stv 1.0 0.9)`; strategic heuristic rules carry frequency/confidence < 1.0; game-world laws (none today) would carry `(stv 1.0 0.99)`.

## 2. Strategic heuristic rules (`rules.metta`)

Each rule is a PLN `Implication` (situation => recommended action) fired via lib_pln Modus Ponens. All are heuristics, not laws — see §3.

| premise | => recommends | truth | class | fires | rationale |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `(Inheritance $c Undefended)` | `Recommend <entity> Defend` | `(stv 0.9 0.8)` | heuristic | yes | an undefended city is usually worth defending |
| `(Inheritance $c LowFood)` | `Recommend <entity> Food` | `(stv 0.9 0.8)` | heuristic | yes | a food-deficit city should prioritize food |
| `(Inheritance $u Type_settlers)` | `Recommend <entity> Settle` | `(stv 0.8 0.7)` | heuristic | yes | a settler is usually best spent founding a city |
| `(Evaluation (Predicate Threatens) (List $e $t))` | `Recommend <target> Retreat` | `(stv 0.85 0.75)` | heuristic | no | a threatened unit may retreat (Evaluation-form, inert under current lib_pln) |
| `(Priority $c Military)` | `Recommend <entity> BuildDefender` | `(stv 0.9 0.9)` | heuristic | no | a city needing a garrison should build a defender (3-hop chain |
| `(State $c NeedsGrowth)` | `Recommend <entity> Irrigate` | `(stv 0.9 0.9)` | heuristic | no | a food-short city should irrigate for growth (2-hop chain |
| `(State $u ReadyToExpand)` | `Recommend <entity> FoundCity` | `(stv 0.9 0.9)` | heuristic | no | a settler ready to expand should found a city (2-hop chain |

## 3. Game-world laws

**None are represented as atoms today.** Hard legality — a settler can found a city, you cannot move an enemy's unit, a move target must be on the map — is enforced procedurally by `actions.validate_action` (see §4), not asserted as PLN atoms. Convention if a law is ever added as an atom: it MUST carry truth `(stv 1.0 0.99)` (frequency 1, near-certain confidence). No strategic heuristic in §2 may claim frequency 1.0.

## 4. Actions: preconditions & atom linkage

Preconditions mirror `actions.validate_action` (checked in order: known type -> required fields -> entity exists & owned -> move target on-map -> server legal_actions). The actor of an action links to a recommendation entity via the token prefix below.

| action type | required fields | actor | error codes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `city_production` | city_id, production_type | city_id (-> City_<id>) | E203 unknown city, E204 not owned |
| `end_turn` | (none) | (none) | — |
| `tech_research` | tech_id | tech_id (-> Tech_<name>) | — |
| `unit_build_city` | unit_id | unit_id (-> Unit_<id>) | E201 unknown unit, E202 not owned |
| `unit_build_irrigation` | unit_id | unit_id (-> Unit_<id>) | E201 unknown unit, E202 not owned |
| `unit_build_mine` | unit_id | unit_id (-> Unit_<id>) | E201 unknown unit, E202 not owned |
| `unit_build_road` | unit_id | unit_id (-> Unit_<id>) | E201 unknown unit, E202 not owned |
| `unit_fortify` | unit_id | unit_id (-> Unit_<id>) | E201 unknown unit, E202 not owned |
| `unit_move` | unit_id, dest_x, dest_y | unit_id (-> Unit_<id>) | E201 unknown unit, E202 not owned, E210 off-map |
| `unit_sentry` | unit_id | unit_id (-> Unit_<id>) | E201 unknown unit, E202 not owned |
| `unit_skip` | unit_id | unit_id (-> Unit_<id>) | E201 unknown unit, E202 not owned |

Common shape errors: `E100` unknown action type, `E220` missing required field, `E230` not in server legal_actions.

## 5. Recommendation vocabulary

Rules derive `(Recommend <entity> <action>)` atoms. Current actions: `BuildDefender`, `Defend`, `Food`, `FoundCity`, `Irrigate`, `Retreat`, `Settle`.
